package com.notireader.app.domain.services
import android.content.Context import android.content.Intent import android.util.Log import android.widget.Toast import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getString import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.startActivity import com.google.android.datatransport.runtime.scheduling.persistence.EventStoreModule_PackageNameFactory.packageName import com.notireader.app.R
object ShareApp { fun share(context: Context) { try { val appName = getString(context,R.string.app_name) val packageName = packageName val playStoreLink = "https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=$packageName"
val shareText = """ Check out this amazing app: $appName!
Recover your deleted WhatsApp messages and media files effortlessly!
✨ Features: • Recover deleted messages • Save WhatsApp media automatically • Works with both personal and business WhatsApp • Clean and easy interface
Download now: $playStoreLink
#WhatsAppRecovery #MessageRecovery #DataRecovery """.trimIndent()
val shareIntent = Intent().apply { action = Intent.ACTION_SEND type = "text/plain" putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, shareText) putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "Check out $appName") }
startActivity(Intent.createChooser(shareIntent, "Share $appName via")) } catch (e: Exception) { Log.e("xyz", "Error sharing app: ${e.message}") Toast.makeText(context, "Developer's message: You got us, this feature is under development...!!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() } } }

object ShareApp {
fun share(context: Context) { try { val appName = context.getString(R.string.app_name) val packageName = context.packageName val playStoreLink = "https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=$packageName"
val shareText = """ Check out this amazing app: $appName!
Recover your deleted WhatsApp messages and media files effortlessly!
✨ Features: • Recover deleted messages • Save WhatsApp media automatically • Works with both personal and business WhatsApp • Clean and easy interface
Download now: $playStoreLink
#WhatsAppRecovery #MessageRecovery #DataRecovery """.trimIndent()
val shareIntent = Intent().apply { action = Intent.ACTION_SEND type = "text/plain" putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, shareText) putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "Check out $appName") }
context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(shareIntent, "Share $appName via")) } catch (e: Exception) { Log.e("xyz", "Error sharing app: ${e.message}") Toast.makeText(context, "Unable to share app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() } } }

<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="• Reads WhatsApp notifications from your device
• Helps recover deleted messages before they disappear
• Automatically saves media files shared in WhatsApp
• Provides a backup solution for important conversations
• Works with both personal and business WhatsApp accounts

Our app operates entirely on your device and does not send your messages or data to external servers." android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Data Collection --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Data Collection and Processing" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="Information We Process:
• WhatsApp notification content (messages, media, sender information)
• Message timestamps and metadata
• Media files (photos, videos, documents, voice notes)

Information We DO NOT Collect:
• Your WhatsApp account credentials
• Your phone number or contact list
• Messages from other apps
• Personal information beyond notification content
• Location data
• Device identifiers for tracking purposes

All data remains stored locally on your device. We do not transmit, upload, or share your messages with third parties." android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Permissions --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Required Permissions" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="• Notification Access: Required to read WhatsApp notifications
• Storage Access: Required to save and organize media files
• File Access: Required to create backups of your messages

These permissions are used solely for the app's core functionality of message recovery and backup." android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Data Security --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Data Security" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="• All data is stored locally on your device using Android's secure storage
• No data is transmitted to external servers
• Media files are saved in your device's private app directory
• You maintain complete control over your data
• Data is automatically deleted when you uninstall the app" android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- User Rights --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Your Rights and Control" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="• You can disable notification access at any time through Android settings
• You can delete individual messages or entire conversations within the app
• You can clear all app data through Android app settings
• You can uninstall the app to completely remove all stored data
• You have full control over which notifications the app can access" android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Third Party Services --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Third-Party Services" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="Our app may include:
• Google AdMob for advertising (in free version)
• Google Play Billing for premium purchases

These services have their own privacy policies and operate independently from our message reading functionality." android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Important Disclaimers --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Important Disclaimers" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="• Noti Reader is an independent third-party application
• We are not affiliated with WhatsApp Inc., Meta Platforms, or any related companies
• WhatsApp® is a trademark of WhatsApp Inc.
• This app reads publicly available notification data provided by the Android system
• We do not bypass any WhatsApp security measures
• Use of this app is at your own discretion and responsibility" android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Contact --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Contact Us" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="32dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us through the Customer Support option in the app menu.

By using Noti Reader, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy." android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
</LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>
</LinearLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:id="@+id/main" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/deep_charcoal" android:orientation="vertical" tools:context=".presentation.terms_and_condition_screen_activity.TermsAndConditionActivity">
<!-- Header --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@color/elevated_surface_grey" android:elevation="4dp" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingHorizontal="16dp" android:paddingVertical="16dp">
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/backButton" android:layout_width="24dp" android:layout_height="24dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:src="@drawable/ic_arrow_back" android:contentDescription="Back" app:tint="@color/warm_white" />
<TextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Terms and Conditions" android:textColor="@color/warm_white" android:textSize="20sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Content --> <ScrollView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:fillViewport="true" android:scrollbars="vertical">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="20dp">
<!-- Last Updated --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:text="Last updated: September 7, 2025" android:textColor="@color/text_secondary_dark" android:textSize="14sp" android:gravity="center" />
<!-- Introduction --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="Terms of Service" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="By downloading, installing, or using Noti Reader ("the App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the App.

Noti Reader is an independent third-party application developed to help users recover and backup WhatsApp messages through notification reading services. We are not affiliated with WhatsApp Inc. or Meta Platforms, Inc." android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- App Purpose and Functionality --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="1. App Purpose and Functionality" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="Noti Reader provides the following services:

• Notification Reading Service: Monitors WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business notifications to capture message content before deletion
• Message Recovery: Stores received messages locally to prevent data loss
• Media Backup: Automatically saves media files (photos, videos, documents, voice notes, stickers, GIFs) shared in WhatsApp conversations
• Conversation Management: Organizes messages by sender for easy access and review
• Dual Platform Support: Works with both personal WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business applications
• Local Storage: All data is stored locally on your device using Android's secure storage system
• Premium Features: Optional ad-free experience through in-app purchases" android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- User Rights and Obligations --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="2. User Rights and Obligations" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="Your Rights:
• Access and use the App's notification reading services
• Control notification access permissions at any time
• Delete individual messages or entire conversations
• Export or backup your recovered data
• Disable the service through Android settings
• Request support through in-app customer service

Your Obligations:
• Use the App in compliance with applicable laws and regulations
• Respect the privacy and rights of message senders
• Ensure you have proper authorization to backup conversations
• Not attempt to reverse engineer or modify the App
• Not use the App for illegal, harmful, or unauthorized purposes
• Keep your device secure and protect stored data
• Acknowledge that message recovery depends on notification availability" android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Data Collection and Privacy --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="3. Data Collection and Processing" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="Data Processing Activities:
• Reading WhatsApp notification content (messages, sender names, timestamps)
• Extracting media file information from notifications
• Storing message data locally using Android Room Database
• Copying media files to app-specific directories
• Processing notification metadata for organization purposes
• Storing user preferences and app settings

Data Storage:
• All message data is stored locally on your device
• Media files are saved in structured folders within app storage
• No data transmission to external servers
• Data persistence until manual deletion or app uninstallation
• Secure local storage using Android's security framework

Third-Party Services:
• Google AdMob for advertising (free version only)
• Google Play Billing for premium purchases
• These services operate under their respective privacy policies" android:textColor="@color/text_primary_dark" android:textSize="15sp" />
<!-- Service Limitations --> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" android:text="4. Service Limitations and Disclaimers" android:textColor="@color/whatsapp_primary_green" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" android:lineSpacingMultiplier="1.4" android:text="Technical Limitations:
• Message recovery depends on Android notification system availability
• Some messages may not be recoverable if notifications are disabled or blocked
• Media files can only be saved if accessible through Android's document tree API
• App functionality requires specific Android permissions (notification access, storage access)
• Performance may vary based on device specifications and Android version

Service Availability:
• The App is provided "as is" without warranties of continuous availability
• We do not guarantee 100% message recovery success rate
• Functionality may be affected by Android system updates or WhatsApp changes
• Premium features require active subscription

No Affiliation:
• Noti Reader is an independent application not endorsed by WhatsApp Inc.
• We do not bypass any WhatsApp security measures
